summary: St. Joe National Forest, Shoshone County lookout: a 10-foot pole L-4 tower built in 1934 and destroyed in 1969; an October 2023 post describes only concrete footings and a step.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1969; an October 2023 post describes four concrete footings and a concrete step

notes_for_editor: Two detailed sources agree on the 1934 build, the 1969 destruction and the L-4 pole design. Staffing names come only from Idaho Fire Lookouts, which cites a book and the Former Forest Fire Lookout Registry; not checked against those. The drive-up tag is Idaho Fire Lookouts' label; no source states an access level, so none is set. The 2023 footings are from one visitor's post. The record's status 'gone' matches the sources and is not changed. Used 1 search and 3 page reads; no further sources found.
